shared_elements: zones of hatched or chevron-like linear filling
a horizontal band of repeated pattern running across the surface
justification: The only real correspondence is the use of incised linear ornament on stone, including bands of dense hatched/chevron filling that run horizontally across each surface. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a flat slab carved in raised relief with recognisable animals, birds and humanoid figures stacked in registers, while B is a rounded vessel covered edge-to-edge in shallow, purely abstract geometric incision with no figures at all.
